papers.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
papers.desc: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities.

papers.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
papers.desc: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive.

papers.title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
papers.desc: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes.

papers.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
papers.desc: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding.

papers.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
papers.desc: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI.

papers.title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.desc: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but the quadratic cost of 3D full attention dominates their inference.

papers.title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
papers.desc: Blockchain forensics is adversarial and open-ended: money launderers split, swap, and bridge funds, cut their trail at mixers or custodial services, and change tactics from one incident to the next.

papers.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
papers.desc: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act.

papers.title: Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
papers.desc: Language agents increasingly act through external tools and interactive environments, making the interface between the model and its executable capabilities part of the decision process.

papers.title: Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
papers.desc: Developers download quantized large language models (LLMs) from public registries to run them locally.

papers.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
papers.desc: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms.

papers.title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
papers.desc: We present EasyProver, a Lean proving system built from recursive agents with isolated contexts, asynchronous search, parallel tactic probing, and an elastic elaboration service.

papers.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
papers.desc: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible.

papers.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
papers.desc: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time.

papers.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
papers.desc: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process.
